blocks.text: PARIS, France — Paris Women’s Fashion Week wraps up Tuesday after nine days of shows and celebrity sightings. AFP looks at some of the trends that will influence women’s wardrobes for the Spring-Summer season next year. Fashion in kit form Instead of outfits conceived as complete looks, designers have this season largely begun breaking them down into independent pieces that can be mixed and matched by buyers. “The emergence of separates has become a key theme of this season, as we took our signature silhouettes, gowns, necklines, and reimagined them as tops and bottoms,” Schiaparelli designer Daniel Roseberry said in his […]...
